site.name: Muntanya Jiu-Jitsu
site.tagline: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu in the Pallars Sobirà

hero.heading: Muntanya Jiu-Jitsu
hero.subheading: Small-town Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu in the Pallars Sobirà. Train respect, effort and community on the mats in Sort.

escola.heading: The school
escola.intro: Muntanya Jiu-Jitsu is Sort's BJJ school, open to adults and kids. We train at a village pace: close-knit, demanding when it matters, no rush.

values.title: Respect
values.desc: On the mats everyone is equal, from white belt to black belt.

values.title: Effort
values.desc: Progress comes from consistency, not natural talent.

values.title: Community
values.desc: A training family, on and off the mats.

instructor.heading: The instructor
instructor.name: Pablo
instructor.bio: Pablo runs Muntanya Jiu-Jitsu with the goal of bringing high-level Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu to the Pallars, for adults and kids.
instructor.lineageText: Pablo trained at Ases Jiu-Jitsu (València) under Ezekiel Zayas, a black belt since 2010, founder of Ases Jiu-Jitsu and technical director of Team Ganbaru. Zayas is a multiple-time IBJJF black belt European champion and international referee.

horaris.heading: Schedule
horaris.note: All classes take place at the Poliesportiu Municipal de Sort.
